messages.subject: Consultation
parts:
I was fitting a spatiotemporal model using the INLA approach. The outcome variable was collected for a couple of years. 
But almost all the co-variates I used are not dynamic (e.g., neighbourhood socioeconomic status). 


Given the covariates were collected at a single time point, is that fair to employ a spatio-temporal model? 


Do you think a spatial model without a time component is preferable? 


Thank you!  

Wubet
